sourceEvidence.title: Full Time Area Production Director
sourceEvidence.quote: Full Time Area Production Director at American Welding & Gas — Greater Orlando. The Area Production Director is responsible for the overall operational leadership, safety, efficiency, and performance of multiple production and fill plant facilities within an assigned region... industrial, medical, specialty, and beverage gas production activities... 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in industrial gas production, manufacturing...

sourceEvidence.title: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Logistics – Development Programs (R5252)
sourceEvidence.quote: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Logistics – Development Programs (R5252) at Shield — Seattle, WA. Shield AI is seeking a highly driven Sr. Manager Materials Planning & Logistics to lead supply planning, material readiness, production planning, and logistics execution for next-generation autonomous aircraft development programs and a new greenfield manufacturing facility... $160,000 - $250,000 a year. On-site. U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance.
